Evan Park: Heads-up: hourly aggregates for metric `feature_flags_activation` missing 2026-03-24 01:00-03:00 UTC (shard 88). Alert fired on dashboard.
Lena Ortiz: I can see zeros for shard 88. Likely late ingest from kafka group ingest-zeta after a schema tweak. Want to do a targeted backfill not full replay.
Marta Ivanova: Agreed. We should run a preview/canary slice and get checksum + sample diffs before any promote. UX ask: console preview should surface routing label, estimated compute units (CU), and estimated wait time for chosen quota_profile.
Evan Park: Proposal: run 1-hour canary on shard 88 with preview=true, emit_samples=15, and emit_invalidation_preview=true. If checksum delta < 0.2% and sample diffs look normalization-only, schedule promote in off-peak with fair-share quota cap=400 CU.
Marta Ivanova: I'll kick off the preview. Internal API call (example): ```bash
curl -X POST https://internal-api/recompute \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -d '{"range":"2026-03-24T01:00:00Z/2026-03-24T02:00:00Z","shards":[88],"preview":true,"emit_samples":15,"emit_invalidation_preview":true,"quota_profile":"background"}'
```
replay-bot: Job queued: preview-1718702468-088 (status: queued)
Evan Park: Also ask console to include estimated cost and routing tier next to the preview link so reviewers can choose quota_profile with visibility.
Lena Ortiz: Add routing policy: auto-cancel promoted runs if preview returns schema mismatch or checksum delta > 0.5%. For deltas between 0.2% and 0.5% require manual sign-off.
Marta Ivanova: Preview finished: checksum delta 0.06%, sample diffs are timestamp normalization and one small field rename. Invalidation preview keys: inv:feature_flags_activation:shard:88:20260324T01. Estimated CU: 95, est wait (background): ~10m.
Evan Park: Sounds safe. Please schedule promote with quota=fair-share, quota_cap=400, cost_cap=800, and enable post_promote_smoke to validate dashboards after first 10% progress.
Marta Ivanova: Promote queued. Curl for promote (internal): ```bash
curl -X POST https://internal-api/recompute \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -d '{"range":"2026-03-24T01:00:00Z/2026-03-24T03:00:00Z","shards":[88],"preview":false,"quota":"fair-share","quota_cap":400,"cost_cap":800,"invalidate_on_promote":true,"post_promote_smoke":true,"schedule":"2026-03-24T02:30:00Z"}'
```
replay-bot: Promote run queued: promote-1718702720-088 (status: queued)
Lena Ortiz: I'll monitor. If smoke shows >0.5% delta we abort and escalate to data-platform. Please post final summary here once complete.
